difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that local finiteness of type is fppf local on the source (statement lines 7045-7049). The proof checks the four clauses of the chapter's general criterion for a property to be local on the source: Zariski locality on source and target, preservation under composition, the fact that a flat morphism locally of finite presentation is locally of finite type, and finally the descent clause, which is the algebra statement that finite type descends along a surjective etale (hence fppf) map of affines, quoted as the last condition of the criterion (proof lines 7051-7062). The level is H2: the clause-by-clause verification is short but explicit, and the one nontrivial clause is identified by name.
